# area51.monster

> Area 51 domain and narrative IP for sale. Alien spacecraft hangars, subterranean tunnels to the Pacific, and a development-ready film/series concept. Owned by DesertRich (desertrich.com). Contact: sales@desertrich.com

The site presents a fictional narrative property built around the Area 51 excavation mythos. It is independent, not affiliated with any government entity.

## Pages

- [The Excavation Story](https://area51.monster/story/): Lore behind the volume of earth removed from Area 51 — bedrock hangars, tunnel network, Pacific terminal
- [Film & Series Concept](https://area51.monster/film-concept/): Logline, synopsis, and format options for feature or series development
- [Acquisition](https://area51.monster/acquisition/): Domain sale, script/IP licensing, and acquisition process
- [FAQ](https://area51.monster/faq/): Common questions on the domain, the story, and how to make an offer
